integrity: Proof, comparisons, and self-contained reproducible finite checks are embedded. No independent mathematical audit has been performed; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty equivalence frames with full powerset Boolean reducts only. Dual-frame support subsets are not the same objects as embedded algebra retract subalgebras. The 2007 article on monadic Boolean endomorphisms and the 2006 article on finite monadic subalgebras were only partially accessible, so an implicit antecedent remains possible. The finite verification suite supplements but does not replace the proof.
title: Minimum-cluster nuclei and complete retraction-rank spectra of finite S5 modal algebras
